title:
Epic to handle creating new vector stores

This epic listens for CREATE_VECTOR_STORE actions from the VectorStoreCreateForm.
If isNewEntity is true (custom entity type), it first creates the entity type using Pkg.upsertType.
Then it makes a tunneledAjax call to upsert the new GenaiCore.VectorStore.Pg entity.
Upon successful creation, it updates the vector store cache.
name: HandleCreateVectorStoreEpic
